definitions.gloss: branch office; local office; field office; agency
definitions.explanation: A smaller satellite office of a larger organization, typically a government agency or company, set up in a different location to provide services closer to the local population.

examples.japanese: {市役所|しやくしょ}の{出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}で{手続|てつづ}きをする。
examples.english: To complete paperwork at the city hall branch office.

examples.japanese: この{地区|ちく}には{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}の{出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}がある。
examples.english: There is a post office branch in this district.

examples.japanese: {住民票|じゅうみんひょう}は{最寄|もよ}りの{出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}でも{取得|しゅとく}できます。
examples.english: Residence certificates can also be obtained at the nearest branch office.

notes:
Combines {出張|しゅっちょう} (dispatching) + {所|じょ} (place). Most commonly refers to local government satellite offices that handle routine administrative services closer to residents.

COMMON SERVICES:
- {住民票|じゅうみんひょう}の{発行|はっこう}: issuing residence certificates
- {戸籍|こせき}{謄本|とうほん}の{取得|しゅとく}: obtaining family register copies
- {届出|とどけで}の{受付|うけつけ}: accepting notifications and applications

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市役所|しやくしょ}の{出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}: city hall branch office
- {最寄|もよ}りの{出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}: nearest branch office
- {出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}で{手続|てつづ}きをする: to complete procedures at a branch office

RELATED WORDS:
- {支所|ししょ}: sub-office (similar to {出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}, sometimes used interchangeably)
- {支店|してん}: branch (for private companies and banks)
- {本庁|ほんちょう}: main office of a government body
- {出張|しゅっちょう}: business trip (the base word, with a different meaning)
